Vaani.intelligence.personality#

Personality Engine - Voice & Behavior Customization#

Features: - Configurable personality traits (helpful, friendly, professional) - Tone adaptation based on context - Mood tracking and appropriate responses - Cultural awareness and sensitivity - Humor and casual conversation support - Response style customization - Personality profiles (formal, casual, witty)

Defines Vaani’s personality and interaction style. Makes conversations feel natural and human-like with consistent character traits.
